title: Apply four visual strategies to the tree page

parts.text: Apply the decision tree, mockup, network graph and choice-driven views to the tree page, under one design.
Four haiku subagents surveyed the strategies in parallel.
A decision tree shows one question at a time; a pick folds its siblings, and a click restores them.
A running view of the answers so far is redrawn on every pick.
A click on a node keeps its neighbours and fades the rest; Esc restores the whole graph.
A fixed-width text wireframe stands in for a screen with no image.
What should a pick do to the other Options?
Owner's complaint: buttons in odd places.

pick.text: Fold them into one stub line

parts.text: One click on the stub brings them back.

What should I do about Acme?

 [1] Offer 15% instead   <- your pick
     + 3 other options

 Tie it to a longer contract?
 [1] Only with 2 years   [2] For one year

else.text: Hide them; Esc brings them back

parts.text: A mouse user cannot find the way back.
The page stays as long as before the pick.
What opens the Whole plan?

pick.text: Your choices: one row per Decision

parts.text: Each row shows the pick and its facts; a click reopens the Decision.

Your choices
 1  Other Options  Fold into a stub
 2  Whole plan     Your choices
 3  Card click     Focus it

               [[ Copy answer ]]
The answers so far are read card by card.
What does a click on a Whole plan card do?
Its parent, its children and every Part with the same source stay; the rest fade.
Esc or a second click shows the whole plan again.
Parts that share a source stay apart on the page.
A card with children folds them to a count and unfolds on a second click.
A text wireframe cannot show colour or images.
The shared design system of #1011 stays deferred; this page keeps one design of its own.
